1. Quickstart examples
----------------------

The following examples present the main functionalities of MAPIE through basic quickstart regression problems.


.. raw:: html

    <div class="sphx-glr-thumbnails">

.. thumbnail-parent-div-open

.. raw:: html

    <div class="sphx-glr-thumbcontainer" tooltip="Mondrian is a method that allows to build prediction sets (for classification) and prediction intervals (for regression) with a group-conditional coverage guarantee. To achieve this, it runs a conformal prediction procedure for each of these groups, and hence achieves marginal coverage on each of them.">

.. only:: html

  .. image:: /examples_mondrian/1-quickstart/images/thumb/sphx_glr_plot_main-tutorial-mondrian-regression_thumb.png
    :alt:

  :ref:`sphx_glr_examples_mondrian_1-quickstart_plot_main-tutorial-mondrian-regression.py`
